G1 only checks that this task axis changes episode outcomes at ignition budget; it cannot and must not speak about history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: none in M3214: G1 measures task-condition outcome ignition only; history-necessity tests remain reserved for the full-budget pre-registered experiments

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: A G1 fail verdict routes to the pre-registered Outcome B/D analogue: the full 20-cell matrix is cancelled and the task design is reworked; thresholds are never weakened and the budget is never silently extended.
